newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS starts Eletrobras as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS starts Eletrobras as buy.

text.p: -- UBS Securities initiated coverage of Centrais Eletricas Brasileiras SA (Eletrobras) as a buy.
-- UBS said it expects Electrobras' earnings to increase 11 percent in 1997 and pro-forma earnings to increase 18 percent in 1998.
-- UBS set a 12-month price target of $510 per thousand shares, up from its current stock price of $348 per thousand shares.
-- UBS sees Electrobras benefitting from a stronger cash-flow position from the sale of its minority stakes in other electric companies.
-- The firm also sees Electrobras' privatization following a more definite course than is currently expected by the market.
